title: U.S. refrigerated warehouse capacity by state and storage type
values: Space columns are in thousands of cubic feet. Warehouse count columns are counts. Each record uses the units and precision published in the source.
coverage: The two biennial surveys describe qualifying food-storage warehouses. The figures describe reported and estimated storage capacity on October 1 of each survey year.
